content: Rehmannia glutinosa, also known as dì huáng (地黄) or gān dì huáng (干地黄) in traditional Chinese medicine, is one of the 50 fundamental herbs utilized in this ancient medical system. Historically, one of its traditional applications has been in the treatment of tinnitus and hearing loss. Scientific evidence suggests that this plant exhibits efficacy in scavenging free radicals, which are implicated in noise-induced hearing loss. The roots of Rehmannia glutinosa, whether fresh or processed, have been found to contain a variety of bioactive constituents. These include iridoids, phenethyl alcohol glycosides, glycosides, cyclopentanoid monoterpenes, and norcarotenoids, all of which contribute to its pharmacological properties.
